title: RFC 6585 section 4: 429 Too Many Requests
supports: Section 4: exhausted-quota rejection, optional Retry-After, and deliberately unspecified identity/counting algorithm.

title: RFC 9110 section 10.2.3: Retry-After
supports: Section 10.2.3: Retry-After is an HTTP date or nonnegative integer delay in seconds, not simulator milliseconds.

title: INCR: rate-limiter counter patterns
supports: Rate-limiter patterns: time-keyed counters, attempt counting, coordinated increment/expiry and the failure gap between separate operations; implementation reference, not an emulated Redis model.

title: API Gateway REST API request throttling
supports: Product-specific token-bucket rate/burst terminology and explicit best-effort target caveat; does not establish this simulator as a provider emulator.
